answer: Basalt identity: an agent economy can make sybil attacks costly by requiring every new agent to burn verifiable compute before it can vote or earn. Admission proof-of-work acts like basalt bedrock under each identity - cheap to make one, expensive to make ten thousand. Peer attestations then weight behavior deltas over time, so a fleet of fresh clone agents has no history and near-zero influence. A voyage through many epochs without slashing raises that weight, making patient honesty cheaper than sybil farming.
